title: A measurement offers a corner radius it has nothing to round
goal: Pick a measurement and the Appearance section offers a Corner Radius slider, under the parts that paint it. A caliper and its readout chip have no corners the slider reaches: pulling it does nothing you can see. Take the row off a measurement, so the section never offers a control that cannot answer.
notes: Seen on the probe on 2026-09-09 while building a-measurement-s-parts-live-in-appearance-like-ev, and visible in every screenshot of that audit: queue/audits/2026-09-09-measure-parts-1-panel-sc.png shows Corner Radius 0 px under Chip Text on a picked measurement. Reproduce with Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/measure-parts-walk.json and look at measure-parts-1-panel-sc.png. Not caused by that work: the row comes from EditorState.corneredRadiusSelection, which calls document.cornerRadiusSelection(layerIDs:cornersOnly:true) and evidently counts a measure layer as cornered. The fix belongs in whatever cornersOnly tests, in PhotonzCore, with a test first.
acceptance: A picked measurement shows no Corner Radius row in Appearance
A picked rectangle, frame, picture and label still show theirs, unchanged
A measurement picked together with a rectangle shows the row for the rectangle and says it reaches one of the two

log.note: UX-PATTERNS section 4 now sorts your case explicitly (v1.9, 2026-09-14, 'A control that can only act over part of its range'). A measurement is 'nothing to act on', not a clamped control: there is no true number to report at any value, the way an arrow has no width. The answer is no row at all, which is what this task already says, and it comes from the ladder's field row rather than being a one-off. Do NOT draw it as a spent or clamped slider: that treatment is only for a range something else is refusing you, and nothing refuses you here.

Reproduced, at both ends. The panel: queue/audits/2026-09-09-measure-parts-1-panel-sc.png shows Corner Radius 0 px under Chip Text on a picked measurement. The model: a new test in EffectsListTests failed exactly as described, cornerRadiusSelection(layerIDs:[caliper], cornersOnly:true) came back with one member for a measure layer.

Fix is one clause in Layer.hasCorners (PhotonzCore/CornerRadiusSelection.swift): a layer whose content is .measure has no corners, beside the existing rule for a path. Three tests written first: a measurement brings no row; box, label, picture and frame each still bring one; a measurement plus a rectangle brings one row that says 'Applies to 1 of the 2 selected layers'. Scripts/test.sh green, 7329 tests.

Adversarial pass before building: the row could have been shown spent or clamped instead, but UX-PATTERNS section 4 sorts this as 'nothing to act on' rather than a clamped range, and the 2026-09-14 note on this task says the same. No row is the shortest thing that is also the honest thing. Checked nothing else reads hasCorners in a way a measurement cares about: CornerRadiusHandles needs an annotation, SelectionOutlineShape now marks a caliper square, which is what it was already drawing at radius 0.

Could NOT run any walk: the Mac's screen was locked for the whole task. Scripts/playtest.sh and playtest-all.sh both reported COULD NOT RUN, so there is no fresh picture of the panel and the app-level acceptance is proven through the core function the panel reads rather than on screen. Added the missing assertion to Scripts/playtest/measure-parts-walk.json (Slider in Corner Radius, present false) and asked for a sweep so it runs once the screen is unlocked.

left rough: the readout chip's own corners still have no control anywhere, and taking this row away does not give anybody one. It is a new idea rather than a defect, so no task: if it is wanted it belongs in the Chip block beside Chip size. In the audit's rough list for the user to react to.

left rough: a group holding ONLY measurements used to reach its Corner Radius through to them and do nothing visible; it now falls back to masking the group's own box, which clips. Checked in a scratch test (members=1, reachedInto=0, the member is the group). That is the documented fallback every container with nothing roundable inside it already uses, so it is consistent rather than broken.
Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-15-measure-no-corner-radius.json. No screenshot, and it says why in rough.
